items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations and has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (VULN-39341) to address the flaw, which has a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: This authorization bypass flaw in Adobe Commerce allows low-privileged authenticated attackers to bypass security features and read select data. It affects Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source.

items.title: Apply updates to patch critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: Adobe released security updates to patch multiple vulnerabilities, including a critical one in Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation. Threat actors are attempting to exploit the critical vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges. It has a CVSS score of 9.1.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability (part of APSB26-92)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-92, could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.
